name: Dumbbell Fly (Flat)
description: Flat-bench dumbbell fly — chest stretch and adduction work.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells over the chest, palms facing in, slight elbow bend. Lower the dumbbells out in an arc until you feel a chest stretch. Bring them back together by squeezing the chest.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
description: Dumbbell front raise — anterior-delt isolation.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with dumbbells in front of thighs. Raise one or both dumbbells to shoulder height with straight arms, lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: Side-raise for the lateral deltoid — the signature shoulder isolation lift in bodybuilding.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with dumbbells at sides, slight forward tilt. Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, leading with the elbows. Pause, lower slowly. Stop before the top-out if the traps take over.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
description: Vertical push — the most neglected pattern for climbers.
instructions_excerpt: Stand or sit tall with dumbbells at shoulder height, elbows slightly in front of the torso. Press overhead until arms are straight with biceps near ears. Maintain a braced core; ribs tucked (no excessive arching). Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
description: Supine pullover — opens the lats and chest while strengthening the serratus/lat connection that strikers and grapplers both underuse.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine on a bench, feet flat. Hold one dumbbell with both hands, arms extended over the chest. Keep a slight bend in the elbows and lower the weight back over the head until you feel a strong stretch in the lats/chest. Return to start.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly
description: Horizontal shoulder abduction with dumbbells — posterior deltoid and mid-trap strength for posture and antagonist balance.
instructions_excerpt: Hinge at hips with dumbbells hanging. Keeping slight elbow bend, raise DBs out to the sides until arms parallel to floor. Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
description: Dumbbell shrug — upper-trap isolation with neutral-grip dumbbells.
instructions_excerpt: Hold heavy dumbbells at the sides. Shrug shoulders straight up, squeeze, lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
description: Unilateral row — corrects side-to-side imbalance common in one-sided climbers.
instructions_excerpt: Place one knee and hand on a bench, torso parallel to the floor. Hold a dumbbell in the opposite hand with arm hanging. Row the dumbbell to the hip, driving the elbow up and back, without rotating the torso. Lower with control.

name: Eccentric Step-Down (Ski Descent)
description: Slow eccentric unilateral descent — the single most transfer-friendly drill for ski-specific quad strength.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on an 8-12 in box on one foot. Slowly lower the opposite heel to tap the floor over 4-5 seconds, then drive back up. Keep hips level and knee tracking over toes.

name: Eccentric-Focused Back Squat (Skier Prep)
description: Back squat with a 4-5s eccentric — ski-specific quad eccentric load.
instructions_excerpt: Standard back squat, but descend over 4-5 seconds under full control. Stand back up at normal tempo.

name: Eggbeater Simulation (Banded)
description: Seated alternating hip-rotation against bands — simulates the eggbeater kick used in water polo and artistic swimming.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on a bench, thighs parallel. Loop a band around each ankle anchored outward. Alternate circles at each hip (one in, one out) with controlled rhythm for 30-60s.

name: Equestrian Core Rotation Sit-Up
description: Sit-up with rotational reach — torso stability for posting, 2-point, jumping.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine with knees bent. Sit up, reaching one arm across the opposite knee. Return. Alternate. 8 per side.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
description: Curl with EZ (cambered) bar — wrist-friendly biceps lift.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with EZ bar at thighs, grip the angled portion. Curl to shoulders, lower with control.

name: Face Pull (Cable or Band)
description: External rotation + scap retraction — both antagonist and prehab.
instructions_excerpt: Attach a rope handle to a cable at face height (or loop a band). Grip the rope with thumbs pointing back. Pull toward the face with elbows high and wide, ending with hands near ears and shoulder blades squeezed. Pause. Return under control.

name: Farmer Carry Loaded Hike
description: Bilateral loaded carry — bread-and-butter snowshoe, ski tour, and mountaineering prep.
instructions_excerpt: Hold heavy dumbbells / kettlebells at sides (or wear a weighted pack). Walk 30-60 m at a brisk pace. Keep posture tall; breathe through the effort.

name: Farmer's Carry
description: Loaded carry — total-body tension, grip, postural endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Hold heavy dumbbells, kettlebells, or trap bar at sides with a strong grip. Stand tall, ribs down, shoulders packed. Walk 40-60 feet with strict posture. Rest. Repeat.

name: Floor Press (Barbell)
description: Barbell bench press from the floor — partial ROM with hard pause for lockout strength.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on the floor under a barbell in a rack or with spotters. Lower the bar until the upper arms touch the floor, pause briefly, then press. Eliminates leg drive.

name: Forward Lunge (Dumbbell)
description: Dumbbell forward lunge — classic alternating-leg loaded lunge.
instructions_excerpt: Hold dumbbells at the sides. Step forward into a lunge, drop the back knee under control, then push back to the start.

name: Front Plank
description: Standard prone plank — anti-extension core endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders, body in a straight line. Brace through the core, glutes, and quads. Hold the position.

name: Front Squat (Barbell)
description: Upright-torso barbell squat with front-rack load — quad-dominant strength that preserves a tall posture valuable for athletes.
instructions_excerpt: Set the bar in a front rack (elbows high). Step back from the rack. Descend to at least parallel with knees tracking over toes. Stand tall. Reset.

name: Glider Harness Sit Iso
description: Supine-ish iso holding a seated-harness position — hang-glider / paraglider specific.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on the floor, lean back about 45 degrees supported by forearms. Hold that angle with legs straight forward at hip height. Hold 30-60s.

name: Glute-Ham Raise (GHR)
description: GHD glute-ham raise — knee-flexion hamstring lift with hip-extension assist.
instructions_excerpt: Set up on a glute-ham developer, knees just behind pad. Start with torso vertical, lower under control until horizontal, then curl back up by contracting hamstrings.

name: Goblet Squat
description: Front-loaded squat with a dumbbell or kettlebell — the best squat regression.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height with both hands cupping the top. Feet shoulder-width. Descend by breaking at hips and knees to at least parallel. Keep chest up and elbows down. Drive back up.

name: Hack Squat (Machine)
description: Sled-style hack squat — supported squat pattern with heavy quad emphasis.
instructions_excerpt: Position shoulders under pads, feet shoulder-width on platform. Descend until thighs are parallel, drive up through full foot to lockout.

name: Half-Kneeling Cable Chop (Golf)
description: Cable chop from half-kneeling — trains rotational power without locking the hips.
instructions_excerpt: Half-kneel sideways to a cable stack. Pull a high-attachment handle down and across with both hands to the far hip. 8-10 per side.

name: Half-Kneeling Cable Chop (High-to-Low)
description: Diagonal chop from high to low in a half-kneeling stance — core + hip stability for paddlers and surfers.
instructions_excerpt: Half-kneel perpendicular to a cable anchored high. Grip the handle with both hands at the high-side shoulder. Chop diagonally down and across toward the opposite hip. Control the return.

name: Half-Kneeling Cable Lift
description: Anti-rotation lift in half-kneeling — builds the diagonal chain (hip to opposite shoulder) used in throwing and batting.
instructions_excerpt: Half-kneel with the outside knee down, cable anchored low to that side. Grip the handle with both hands. Lift the handle diagonally across the body up to overhead on the opposite side. Control the return.

name: Half-Kneeling Cable Rotation
description: Rotational strength in a narrow base — translates directly to rotational sports.
instructions_excerpt: Half-kneel perpendicular to a cable column, cable at chest height. Grip the handle with both hands at the near shoulder. Rotate the torso away from the cable, pressing out. Return under control.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Neutral-grip curl — brachialis and brachioradialis bias.
instructions_excerpt: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other. Curl without rotating the wrist. Lower with control.

name: Handstand Wall Hold
description: Wall-supported handstand — foundational inversion for gymnasts, yogis, calisthenics athletes.
instructions_excerpt: Kick up to a handstand with the belly facing a wall or back against a wall. Stack shoulders over wrists. Hold 20-45 seconds. Focus on active shoulders and stacked body.

name: Hang-Glide Prone Arm Hold
description: Prone on a bench with arms extended forward — direct transfer to hang-gliding harness pose.
instructions_excerpt: Lie prone on a bench, arms extended straight ahead gripping a bar or edge, feet together. Hold 30-60s. 3 sets.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
description: Hanging from a pull-up bar, raise knees to hip height — core and hip-flexor work.
instructions_excerpt: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight. Raise knees toward the chest by flexing hips and lower abs. Lower under control without swinging.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Hanging knee/leg raise — strong core and grip endurance, directly transferable to paddling posture control.
instructions_excerpt: Hang from a bar with a full grip. Without swinging, raise the legs (bent or straight depending on ability) to at least hip height. Lower slow.

name: Harness Hike Simulation (Isometric)
description: Loaded hip-hike hold simulating a windsurf/kite harness lean — postural-endurance staple.
instructions_excerpt: Anchor a heavy band at hip height. Clip harness or loop to waist. Lean back, shoulders, hips, heels in one line, hands on the line for grip. Hold 30-45 seconds.

name: HEMA Longsword Cut Pattern
description: Diagonal cutting pattern with a weighted stick or sword simulator — HEMA-specific.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a weighted stick (3-5 lb) in both hands. Cut diagonal-down left, diagonal-down right, vertical. 8-12 reps per pattern.

name: Highland-Games Throw Stance Iso
description: Wide split-stance hold with rotation load — simulates the delivery-position for highland games throws.
instructions_excerpt: Wide split-stance, front foot flat, rear on ball, band anchored low-side. Hold the loaded-rotation position 20-45s per side.

name: Hiking Bench Isometric Hold
description: Reclined quad + core isometric mimicking the hiking-out position on a dinghy or keelboat.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on a bench edge with feet hooked under a stable strap or partner's hands. Lean back 20-30° from vertical, thighs parallel to the ground, torso straight. Hold 30-90 seconds.

name: Hip Abduction (Machine)
description: Seated machine hip abduction — glute medius and minimus work.
instructions_excerpt: Sit in the machine, pads outside thighs. Press knees apart against resistance, squeeze glutes, return with control.

name: Hip Adduction (Machine)
description: Seated machine hip adduction — adductor strengthening.
instructions_excerpt: Sit in the machine, pads inside thighs. Squeeze knees together against resistance, return with control.

name: Hip-Hop Freeze Pose Hold
description: Low shoulder-weighted freeze pose — hip-hop/breaking specific.
instructions_excerpt: From a low squat, plant hands beside feet, shift weight onto arms and hold with feet off ground 5-10s. 3-5 reps.

name: Hollow Body Hold
description: Gymnastics-standard core hold — full-body compression essential for handstands and levers.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine. Press low back into the floor. Lift shoulders and straight legs 4-6 inches off the floor. Arms overhead. Hold 20-45 seconds.

name: Hollow Hold
description: Gymnastic anti-extension hold — total trunk tension.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on back. Press low back flat. Lift arms and legs a few inches off the floor, keeping the low back pressed. Hold.

name: Iaido Nukitsuke Draw Isometric
description: Half-draw sword isometric hold — iaido-specific shoulder and grip control.
instructions_excerpt: Assume iaido seiza or tachi-iai. Half-draw a light bokken/iaito, hold the position 20-45s. Focus on slow controlled tension.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
description: Incline (30-45°) barbell bench press — upper-chest and front-delt bias.
instructions_excerpt: Set bench to 30-45°. Grip slightly wider than shoulders, unrack, lower to upper chest, press to lockout. Keep ribs over hips, do not flare the elbows.

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
description: Incline dumbbell press — upper chest with independent arm path.
instructions_excerpt: Set bench to 30-45°. Press dumbbells from shoulder level to lockout, palms facing forward or slightly inward. Lower with control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
description: Curl on incline bench — bias toward long-head of biceps via shoulder extension.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on incline bench (45-60°), dumbbells hanging at sides. Curl without lifting the elbows forward. Lower fully each rep.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
description: Incline dumbbell fly — upper-chest stretch and adduction.
instructions_excerpt: Set bench to 30-45°. Hold dumbbells over the chest with a slight elbow bend. Lower the dumbbells out in an arc, then squeeze them back together.

name: Inverted Row
description: Horizontal bodyweight pull — home-friendly row alternative.
instructions_excerpt: Set a barbell in a rack at hip height (or use a sturdy table). Lie underneath, grip the bar shoulder-width, body straight. Pull the chest to the bar by driving elbows down and back. Lower under control.

name: Iso Hike Hold (Trekking Pole Sim)
description: Low split-stance isometric hold with poles — recreates the loaded pause on steep hiking.
instructions_excerpt: Assume a split stance. Hold light dumbbells (as trekking-pole proxies) tip-down. Hold low, back-knee just off floor, 20-30 seconds. Switch legs.

name: Isometric Bow-Draw in Field Positions
description: Archer draw isometric from kneeling / sitting / canted positions — specific to bow hunting's awkward field postures.
instructions_excerpt: Using a resistance band at draw weight, assume a field position (kneeling, seated on the ground, leaning into a tree). Draw to anchor and hold 10-15 seconds. Release with control. Rotate positions across sets.

name: Karate Front-Kick Hold
description: Extended-position front-kick isometric — karate kick-chamber and hip-flexor strength.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall. Chamber one knee to chest, extend the kick and hold 5-10 sec. 4-6 per side.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Posterior-chain-dominant ballistic hip hinge — power-endurance foundation.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with a kettlebell an arm's length in front. Hinge to grip it with both hands. Hike it back between the legs, then snap the hips forward to launch the bell to chest height. Let it fall by hinging, redirect with a hike pass, repeat.

name: Kneeling Banded Chop (Water Polo Shot Sim)
description: High-to-low banded chop from a half-kneeling stance — simulates the torso-driven polo shot.
instructions_excerpt: Anchor band high. Half-kneel sideways. Grip with both hands, pull the band across and down diagonally, finishing at the far hip. Return under control.

name: Kneeling Pallof Press with Rotation
description: Tall-kneeling Pallof press that adds a small trunk rotation — bridge between anti-rotation and rotation for paddlers.
instructions_excerpt: Tall-kneel perpendicular to a cable at chest height. Press the handle away from the chest; then slowly rotate the torso 20-30° toward the stack and back. Return the handle to the chest.

name: Kneeling Single-Arm Landmine Press
description: Half-kneeling unilateral landmine press — shoulder-save pressing pattern for paddlers and surfers.
instructions_excerpt: Half-kneel sideways to a landmine. Hold the bar with one hand at shoulder. Press the bar up and slightly across. Return under control.

name: Kung-Fu Horse-Stance Conditioning
description: Classic deep horse-stance hold — foundational kung fu lower-body conditioning.
instructions_excerpt: Stand wide, thighs parallel to ground, back straight, hands at chamber. Hold 30-90s. 3-4 sets.

name: Land-Sailing Hiking Squat Iso
description: Seated hiking iso specific to land-sailing boat stance.
instructions_excerpt: Sit in a deep wide-stance squat with heels pressed down. Grip imaginary sheet lines. Hold 30-60 s.

name: Land-Sailing Steering Iso Pull
description: Seated one-arm band pull and hold — land-yacht steering isometric.
instructions_excerpt: Seated. Band anchored to the side. Pull across the body to a 90-degree holding position. Hold 20-40s per side.

name: Landmine Press
description: Joint-friendly overhead push variation — excellent for older lifters.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in a half-kneeling or standing stance holding the end of a barbell in a landmine attachment at shoulder height. Press the bar up and slightly forward until the arm is extended. Lower under control. Alternate arms.

name: Landmine Rotational Row
description: Bent-over row into the landmine with a rotational finish — trains the pull+rotate pattern under load.
instructions_excerpt: Straddle a landmine barbell. Hinge at the hips, grab the bar sleeve with one hand. Row the bar toward the ribs while rotating the torso slightly open. Lower under control. Alternate sides or complete all reps one side first.

name: Lat Pulldown (Straight-Arm)
description: Straight-arm pulldown on cable — isolates the lat for the pulling phase of the freestyle stroke.
instructions_excerpt: Face a cable machine with handle set high. Grip a straight bar or rope with straight arms. Keep arms straight and pull the bar down to the hips by driving the lats. Return under control.

name: Lat Pulldown (Wide-Grip)
description: Wide-grip lat pulldown — vertical pull for those still working up to bodyweight pull-ups, or for high-volume back work.
instructions_excerpt: Sit at the lat pulldown machine, thighs anchored. Grip bar wide overhand. Pull bar to upper chest, leading with the elbows. Control the return.

name: Lateral Lunge
description: Side lunge — adductor strength and lateral court movement prep.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall. Step out to one side into a wide lunge, bending the stepping-side knee while the other leg stays straight. Push back to center. Alternate sides.

name: Lateral Step-Down (Eccentric)
description: Slow eccentric lateral step-down — quad and glute-med control for sharp lateral court braking.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a 6-10" step on one foot, other leg hanging off the side. Slowly (3-4s) lower the hanging foot to the floor by flexing the standing hip and knee. Return to start. 8-10 per side.

name: Leg Extension
description: Seated machine knee extension — isolated quad work, especially the rectus femoris and VMO.
instructions_excerpt: Sit in the machine, ankles behind the pad. Extend knees fully against resistance, squeeze at the top, lower with control.

name: Leg Press
description: Plate-loaded or selectorized leg press — heavy quad/glute work with supported torso.
instructions_excerpt: Sit in the leg press machine, feet shoulder-width on the platform. Lower the platform until knees track around 90°. Press through full foot to lockout (do not snap knees).

name: Loaded Pack Crouch Walk
description: Low-crouch stalking walk with a pack — foundation for hunting approaches.
instructions_excerpt: Wear a 15-30 lb pack. Walk in a low crouched-knees stance (half-squat) for 30-60 m. Steady, quiet steps.

name: Loaded Reverse Lunge (Pack)
description: Weighted reverse lunge wearing a pack — ass-kicker for hiking-specific leg strength.
instructions_excerpt: Wear a pack or hold dumbbells. Step back into a lunge, back knee just short of the floor. Drive through the front heel to return. Complete reps; switch sides.

name: Loaded Step-Up
description: Weighted step-up — hiking/mountaineering's signature prep exercise.
instructions_excerpt: Hold dumbbells at sides or a barbell on the back. Step up onto a 12-18" box with one foot. Stand tall on top. Lower with control. Complete all reps on one leg before switching.

name: Low-Profile Guard Conditioning
description: Bodyweight defensive low-guard hold + small evasion motions — tactical drill for krav, kung fu.
instructions_excerpt: Assume a deep low guard (elbows tight, knees bent). Hold 30s doing small slips and weight shifts. Rest 30s. 5-6 rounds.
